# Objective

- Fixes #15757 

## Solution

- Add the platform specific property `prefers_home_indicator_hidden` to bevy's Window configuration, and applying it by invoking `with_prefers_home_indicator_hidden` in `winit`.

## Testing

- I have tested the `bevy_mobile_example` on the iOS platform.

## Showcase
- Currently, the `prefers_home_indicator_hidden` is enabled in the bevy_mobile_example demo. You can test it with an iOS device. The home indicator will disappear after several seconds of inactivity in the bottom areas.

issue_context.title: iOS prefersHomeIndicatorAutoHidden()
issue_context.body:
## What problem does this solve or what need does it fill?

Hides the home indicator (the line at the bottom of the window) after a while, like in a lot of games or media apps like YouTube or Netflix.

## What solution would you like?

Calling the Winits [with_prefers_home_indicator_hidden()](https://smithay.github.io/smithay/winit/platform/ios/trait.WindowAttributesExtIOS.html#tymethod.with_prefers_home_indicator_hidden) or even better, have it as window config option.

See also [official docs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/uiviewcontroller/2887510-prefershomeindicatorautohidden).

## What alternative(s) have you considered?

I've tried to query the window and set the Winit settings myself, like in [this fashion](https://www.nikl.me/blog/2023/notes_on_android_development_using_bevy/), but `with_prefers_home_indicator_hidden()` is not just an option but a method.

review_comments:

                    // Only has an effect on iOS
